ABOUT SEERVI

BUILT AROUND TRUST

Seervi is built around trusted sourcing, quality-verified imported items and dependable wholesale supply.

Seervi Trading

Seervi is the name we chose for our company because it is our Sir's name. We source imported items from trusted companies in China and focus on quality-verified products before supplying them to our customers.

Trusted SourcingImported items sourced from trusted companies in China.
Quality FocusProducts are quality-verified as part of our sourcing process.

What We Supply

Wholesale supply for interiors, exteriors and kitchen items, with a growing range of practical products for businesses and projects.

InteriorsProducts for interior applications and finishing.
ExteriorsProducts for exterior and project requirements.
KitchenPractical kitchen-related items for wholesale supply.
WholesaleBusiness-focused quantities and enquiry-based supply.

Transaction data will be deleted. Quotations, rate history and ledger/payment entries linked to this party will be removed. The party profile and login account will remain, so the customer can log in again and still see/edit their profile.
